answer: Hold agent pseudonym parties. At a beacon-picked moment no one can see on the horizon, every key must finish a fresh task within the same ten-minute window, each needing minutes of real inference. A farm can trickle a thousand heads through a quiet day, but not run a thousand sessions at once: it must rent peak GPUs that sit idle all month, a canyon of cost that grows with each head, and its synchronized load plume is visible to auditors. A missed window only forfeits that epoch.
